[OPS] 10, the ops sweep, is live

starter_stories.title: [SEC] 01 · Enrich IP (sub)
starter_stories.use_case: Enrich an IP from several reputation services and return one verdict.

starter_stories.title: [OPS] 01 · Route monitoring alerts
starter_stories.use_case: Receive every production story's monitoring notifications, dedupe them and route them to the ops channel.

starter_stories.credit_estimate_basis: no AI Agent action; Workbench conversations that call it spend Workbench credits
starter_stories.title: [SEC] 02 · Get IP address information (sub)
starter_stories.use_case: Return address information for one IP as a sub-story that can also be enabled as a Workbench tool.

starter_stories.title: [PLT] 01 · Handle Slack approval callbacks (sub)
starter_stories.use_case: Receive Slack interactivity callbacks and hand each approval to the story that asked for it.

starter_stories.title: [PLT] 02 · Track long-running jobs (sub)
starter_stories.use_case: Start a long-running job, return a handle at once, and let callers check its status later.

starter_stories.title: [PLT] 03 · Serve IP enrichment as an API
starter_stories.use_case: Expose IP enrichment to other systems as an authenticated API.

starter_stories.credit_estimate_basis: set at design: runs/day × credits/run observed in dev × 30
starter_stories.title: [SEC] 03 · Look up IOCs from Slack with an agent
starter_stories.use_case: Let an analyst ask in Slack about an indicator and get an agent's summary from the enrichment tools.

starter_stories.credit_estimate_basis: Mode 4 uses no model; it counts as a flow
starter_stories.title: [OPS] 20 · Ops tools (MCP server)
starter_stories.use_case: Serve the ops read tools to AI clients as an MCP server.

starter_stories.credit_estimate_basis: set at design: Workbench conversations draw on unallocated credits, or on the preset team's allocation
starter_stories.title: [PLT] 04 · Open alerts in Workbench from Slack
starter_stories.use_case: Post alerts to Slack with a link that opens Workbench on the alert, with a preset that reaches the ops tools.

starter_stories.title: [PLT] 05 · Research a topic with an agent
starter_stories.use_case: Research a topic with an agent that searches the web and returns a sourced summary.

starter_stories.credit_estimate_basis: set at design: sweep runs/day × observed triage and critic credits × 30
starter_stories.title: [OPS] 10 · Monitor story health and credits
starter_stories.use_case: Sweep every production story for failures, silence and credit burn, and propose fixes for a human to approve.
